title: klndr
seoDescription: klndr, a visual day planner for time-blocking: drag activities onto an hour-by-hour timeline. Built with Nuxt, Firebase, and Tailwind.

modules.text:
klndr is a visual day planner for people who time-block. It bridges the month calendar and the hour-by-hour plan, so a day is something you shape by dragging blocks onto a timeline, not a to-do list you hope fits.

What I built: A month view that shows each day's blocks at a glance, and a day view with a quarter-hour timeline where activities snap, stretch, and nudge with the arrow keys. A reusable library of activity templates (emoji, color, category, usual length), a daily routines checklist, and markdown notes for every date. Accounts with Google sign-in sync across devices, there is a light and dark theme, and the layout switches to bottom sheets and tap-to-place on phones.

Tech stack: Nuxt 3, Vue 3, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Firebase (Auth and Firestore), and signed session cookies with jose. The marketing page is a custom landing with scroll reveals and a live planner mockup.

title: Dokr
seoDescription: Motion-first marketing site for Dokr, a digital banking brand, built in Next.js with GSAP and Framer Motion.

modules.text:
Dokr is a marketing website for a digital banking brand. Its job is to sell a fee-free account, cards, and wealth tools as one confident story, not a dry product list.

What I built: A single-page landing with a letter-flip preloader, mask-reveal headlines, parallax product art, and Lenis smooth scrolling. The page walks from a banking hero into press marks, product offers (payments, investing, wealth, planning), fee-free promises, cards, social proof, a join CTA, and FAQ. Motion is part of the pitch: the site should feel like the bank.

Tech stack: Next.js 13, React 18, TypeScript, styled-components, GSAP, Framer Motion, Lenis, and Geist.

title: Umedio
seoDescription: Marketing site for Umedio, cloud practice management software for private clinics, built in Next.js with GSAP motion.

modules.text:
Umedio is a marketing website for cloud practice management software aimed at private clinics. Its job is to sell an all-in-one platform for bookings, billing, automation, and patient admin so clinicians can spend less time on paperwork.

What I built: A multi-page SaaS marketing site with a deep-teal brand system, GSAP page motion, Lenis smooth scrolling, and product storytelling across home, features, pricing, and a Santis clinic case study. Sections cover online bookings, tasks, leads, inbox, integrations, billing tools, and trust marks from major UK private hospitals.

Tech stack: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Lenis, Swiper, and Headless UI.

title: Realster
seoDescription: Marketing site for a Greater Boston real estate brokerage with search-led home discovery built in Next.js.

modules.text:
Realster is a marketing website for a Greater Boston real estate brokerage. Its job is to help buyers discover homes, explore neighborhoods, book viewings, and connect with agents without feeling like a dry MLS dump.

What I built: A long-form product page that sells the brokerage end to end. A search-led hero opens into homes, private exclusives, neighborhood guides, agent profiles, how-it-works, FAQ, and contact. Motion and scroll polish are part of the pitch: the site itself should feel premium.

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion (Framer Motion), and Lenis smooth scrolling.

title: Photofolio
seoDescription: Motion-first photographer portfolio in Vue 3 for portraits, editorial, and documentary work.

modules.text:
Photofolio is a motion-first portfolio for a freelance photographer. Built around John Doe's practice, it leads with portraits, editorial stories, and documentary coverage, then makes booking a shoot the clear next step.

What I built: A single-page Vue site where the photographs carry the pitch. An SVG wipe loader opens into a split-text hero with a Book a shoot CTA, sticky service cards for portrait sessions, editorial and campaign stills, and events/documentary coverage, a selected-works index with viewport-triggered video previews, about and testimonials, and a full-bleed contact plate. Custom cursor, magnetic buttons, and scroll-linked type keep the interaction craft of the original shell while the product identity is fully photographic.

Tech stack: Vue 3, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP (ScrollTrigger), Lenis, and Lottie.

title: KnowYourGeo
seoDescription: Free GeoGuessr training app with Street View drills, AI coaching, and field guides.

modules.text:
KnowYourGeo is a free training app for GeoGuessr players who want to improve, not just chase a score. You practice on real Google Street View, pin guesses on a map, and leave each round knowing which clues you missed.

What I built: Map pickers (world or by continent), Moving / No Move and timer constraints, AI round review that highlights street signs and regional meta, field guides, and profiles that journal sessions and weak spots. Auth supports email and Google. AI analysis runs on secured, rate-limited server routes so API keys never ship to the browser.

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Google Maps / Street View, Google Gemini, Supabase Auth, and Upstash Redis.

title: Songrates
seoDescription: Music discovery app for rating songs and albums, backed by Apple Music charts and Supabase profiles.

modules.text:
Songrates is a music discovery app built around one loop: find a song or album, then rate it. It turns casual listening into a shared catalog of opinions, playlists, and fully rated releases.

What I built: Home feeds for trending tracks, country Top 100 playlists, and community-rated albums; album pages with track-by-track scoring; reviews; playlists; artist follows; and public profiles with a leveling system unlocked by fully rated albums. Guests can rate; signed-in users keep progress and unlock profile perks.

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase (auth + database), Apple Music API, TanStack Query, and React Three Fiber for upcoming 3D vinyl experiences.

title: Digio
seoDescription: Marketing site for Digio, a next-generation design agency, built in Next.js with Three.js, Motion, and Lenis smooth scrolling.

modules.text:
Digio is a marketing website for a next-generation design agency offering branding, mobile, and web app design. Its job is to sell premium creative work to startups and category leaders, with a bold first impression and a clear path to booking a call.

What I built: A long-form single-page site that opens on a motion-driven hero and moves through an agency intro, by-the-numbers proof, a six-part services list, a selected-work showcase, tiered monthly pricing, testimonials, FAQ, a journal, and a closing call to action. Smooth scrolling, entrance animations, and a 3D layer give it the feel of the studio it represents.

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Three.js with React Three Fiber and Drei, Motion, Lenis, and React Icons.

title: VSCS
seoDescription: Bilingual marketing site for a solar EPC company. Next.js frontend with a Strapi 5 CMS.

modules.text:
VSCS is the company website for VS Construction Services, a Bulgarian solar EPC business. It explains their turnkey photovoltaic offer, showcases completed projects, publishes news, and turns visitors into consultations and leads.

What I built: A bilingual (Bulgarian / English) marketing site with services, project map, blog, careers, and form flows, all editable from a CMS. The frontend revalidates when Strapi content changes, so the client can update copy and media without redeploying the whole app.

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Strapi 5, i18next, Mapbox, GSAP, Lenis, and Nodemailer (SMTP forms). Local CMS uses SQLite; production targets PostgreSQL.

title: Mikrofond
seoDescription: Production WordPress site for a Bulgarian microfinance company. Designed in Figma, built in Elementor Pro.

modules.text:
Mikrofond is the company website for a major Bulgarian microfinance institution. It presents financing products, electronic food vouchers, about content, news, and contact flows for businesses that need a production-ready brand site, not a brochure template.

What I built: Full visual design in Figma, refined over months with a demanding client, then a fully responsive WordPress build in Elementor Pro. Every page is live with entrance animations, animated statistics, dynamic layouts, and custom graphics. Production hardening covered speed work, asset compression, anti-spam protection, and Google Analytics.

Tech stack: WordPress, Elementor Pro, and Figma.

title: Collection of Landing Pages
seoDescription: A Figma collection of landing page concepts across SaaS, retail, and entertainment, showing how I approach design and UX in one file.

modules.text:
A Figma file of landing page concepts I designed across very different industries. It is one place to skim how I think about hierarchy, conversion, and visual tone, from dark SaaS to retail and entertainment.

What I built: Ten complete landing pages in a single showcase. Dark-mode product interfaces, a Japanese snack subscription, an interior studio, a recipe platform, B2B consulting layouts, and a designer portfolio. Each page uses a simple structure, custom components, and type that stays clear at a glance.

Tools: Figma.
